title: DWP v6 verified-autonomy experiment preregistration
status: preregistered targets — not results; every threshold below is an ambition to be tested, and the operative bar is frozen by Task 25 (the powered confirmation design and candidate freeze) before any confirmation result exists
change_policy: Any design amendment happens here, before heldout data, with the original rationale retained. After confirmation data exists, a changed candidate requires a new identity and a fresh untouched partition. Do not adjust effect targets to fit an observed result. Oracle identity is content-addressed: each oracle's defining sources are SHA-256-bound per score record and frozen at the Task 25 freeze (score_pilot.py --dump/--oracle-commitments); an oracle edited after confirmation launch gets a new identity and a disclosed full rescore with both versions — never a silent partial rescore (D15 F1).

baseline_comparator.name: latest-v5
baseline_comparator.recheck_policy: Recheck upstream tags at the confirmation freeze; a newer v5 becomes a new recorded comparator and the affected calibration is redone. The vendored dogfood is never a comparator.

estimands.claim: v6 increases independently accepted task completion under the same resource ceiling as latest stable v5
estimands.unit_of_analysis: task case; repeated runs, cloned copies, test/tool invocations and increments are not new independent tasks
estimands.denominator: all eligible attempted task cases in the partition, intention-to-treat, with infrastructure-ineligible and incomplete categories reported separately under the preregistered exclusion rules
estimands.limitation: Establishes the tested population only; universal superiority is not an attainable guarantee

estimands.claim: v6 reduces total attributable cost per accepted result
estimands.unit_of_analysis: task case; cost is the preregistered attributable aggregate, not bytes or a single counter
estimands.denominator: accepted outcomes in the same eligible attempted workload as the cost numerator; an all-failed workload leaves the ratio undefined and it is never reported as zero
estimands.limitation: Provider-counter semantics must be preserved (input/output/cache/reasoning); missing counters are unknown, not imputed

estimands.claim: v6 improves sustained completion and reduces engineering intervention across interrupted, evolving projects
estimands.unit_of_analysis: project storyline/campaign (six increments), scored per increment and per campaign
estimands.denominator: all scheduled campaigns including aborts; earlier failures are never erased by later repairs
estimands.limitation: With a small number of storylines, uncertainty is substantial; unsupported differences are labeled inconclusive

estimands.claim: Identified v6 mechanisms account for measured gains, and remaining overheads/regressions are known
estimands.unit_of_analysis: ablation cell (component removed) on development cases
estimands.denominator: all ablation runs including the full-component control
estimands.decision_rule: descriptive with intervals; ablations identify contribution and overhead, they do not independently satisfy the launch bar
estimands.limitation: Component contributions on development cases may not transfer to sealed confirmation families

A_no_dwp.workflow: the agent's normal planning, notes, tests and tools
A_no_dwp.exposure: same useful project/task information and documentation; no DWP skill, state, hooks or plan artifacts
A_no_dwp.fairness_rule: never cripple: native planning, notes, tests and context compaction stay allowed; strip only treatment contamination (inherited parent instructions, global DWP installs, prior-run memory); a no-DWP actor never needs a plan file or DWP receipt to succeed

B_latest_v5.exposure: the exact frozen v5 pack snapshot and matched release dependencies
B_latest_v5.fairness_rule: the comparator is the frozen snapshot (baseline_comparator), never the vendored dogfood or mutable main

C_v6_candidate.exposure: the exact frozen candidate pack and dependencies
C_v6_candidate.fairness_rule: the candidate is frozen before the confirmation campaign; findings found mid-campaign go to a later development cycle with a new identity

reviewer_policy.primary_comparison: each pinned package as delivered, with every difference recorded
reviewer_policy.matched_rule: freeze the reviewer version and rule inputs across arms B/C when compatible
reviewer_policy.attribution_rule: a remaining reviewer difference limits attribution and must appear in the claims

tracks.cold_adoption: setup/onboarding plus plan creation, implementation, verification and recovery — reported separately
tracks.already_onboarded: cost of the next matched task once the prescribed harness exists — reported separately; never amortize setup over an invented workload

strata.definition: fixed model/host/tool/reasoning-setting configurations held constant within each block; randomized arm order within stratum with a frozen seed

currently_available.name: codex-cli/gpt-6
currently_available.probe: codex-cli 0.156.1 present (the plan's creating agent ran on GPT-6)

strata.pinning_rule: the operative stratum pair is pinned and recorded in each campaign's META before the first run; a stratum that cannot produce a fresh isolated context is dropped and reported, not silently substituted
strata.routing_note: a v6-only stronger-model option is a secondary routing experiment, never proof of methodology gains

baseline_pilot.purpose: validate apparatus, estimate baseline variance, power the design
baseline_pilot.expression: 12 cases x 2 arms x 2 strata x 2 repeats
baseline_pilot.timing: Task 10; precedes core implementation (Tasks 11-20 depend on this pilot via stage gate G2)
baseline_pilot.status: planned envelope — not an approved bill

v6_development.purpose: repair mechanisms on development cases only; at most three initial bounded rounds
v6_development.expression: 3 arms x development cases x bounded rounds
v6_development.status: bounded by round count and the resource envelope; exact starts recorded at run time

ablations.expression: full v6 + 3 one-component-removed variants + reviewer-sensitivity cells
ablations.status: planned envelope; exact cell sizes fixed at the ablation campaign freeze

confirmation.expression: 60 distinct cases x 3 arms x 2 strata x 3 repeats
confirmation.status: planned envelope — only 60 task clusters; subject to the power/simulation rule and the resource envelope; never launched with an unset envelope
confirmation.sealing: cases and reference solutions authored by the restricted custodian outside implementer access; unseen families are distinct behavioral mechanisms, never new seeds on the same solution pattern; the custodian records the distinctness attestation in the sealed partition's opaque_commitments at freeze, and dev-round skill-text changes are reviewed as mechanism-generic (not dev-case-specific) before the candidate freezes (D15 F5)

quota_protections.lesson: pilot r3 (2026-09-26): 96 sequential starts on one account quota-killed 76 cells mid-campaign; at confirmation scale (1,080 starts) the same failure mode censors the primary endpoint and burns the envelope on dead cells.
quota_protections.pacing: per-provider max starts/hour with a cooldown after any quota signature; values pinned at the Task 25 freeze from QUOTA_EVENT.json evidence
quota_protections.budget_stop: per-provider budget stop: no new starts once the provider's window budget is exhausted; the runner records the stop and resumes in the next window
quota_protections.windows: confirmation starts are split across provider windows by stratum plan — never 1,080 sequential starts in one window
quota_protections.enforcement: campaign schema fields max_starts_per_hour, cooldown_on_quota, budget_stop_per_provider are REQUIRED for confirmation configs; the lab refuses a confirmation config without them (D15 F6)

long_horizon.purpose: sustained completion and intervention behavior on evolving projects
long_horizon.expression: 6 storylines x 3 arms x 2 strata x 2 repeats; six real increments per campaign; sessions counted separately

external_replication.purpose: bounded transfer/adoption evidence on unseen repositories
external_replication.expression: 3 repositories x 2 tasks x 3 arms x 2 strata x 2 repeats
external_replication.status: planned envelope; repository identities, snapshots, task contracts, scorer inputs and replacement rules selected and sealed at the Task 25 freeze before any confirmation result; Task 27 only executes the frozen selections

power_rule: Pilot-based simulation must target the complete joint GO decision: at least 0.80 GO probability under an explicitly justified design alternative with room beyond the thresholds (feasible sensitivity grid: +10/+15/+20 point success changes; 0.80/0.70/0.65 cost ratios). If task clustering dominates, add genuinely distinct cases rather than more repeats. A baseline above 0.90 accepted-rate leaves fewer than ten points of possible improvement — if the launch bar is unattainable for the preregistered population, disclose that and block or relabel exploratory rather than silently choosing easier comparisons. The power simulation reports its input usable-pilot-cell count and refuses to freeze a confirmation size below a preregistered floor of 60 usable pilot cells (r3 mid-recovery: 20/96 usable — below floor; the freeze waits for the recovered inventory) — D15 F11.

launch_bar.statistical_condition: matched estimate meets the target AND the multiplicity-adjusted 95% interval lower bound is above zero
launch_bar.limitation: an assumed true +10-point gain sits exactly on the threshold and does not by itself yield high joint GO probability

launch_bar.statistical_condition: adjusted 95% interval lower bound above zero
launch_bar.limitation: a capable no-DWP baseline bounds the attributable claim

launch_bar.endpoint: cost per accepted outcome vs latest v5
launch_bar.statistical_condition: estimated ratio <= 0.80 AND adjusted 95% upper bound below 1.00
launch_bar.limitation: boundary alternatives (true ratio exactly 0.80) sit on the threshold; provider-counter semantics must be preserved

launch_bar.practical_target: 30% lower where the baseline rate is nonzero
launch_bar.statistical_condition: report absolute rate and ratio with uncertainty; no autonomy-superiority claim unless its own preregistered test passes
launch_bar.limitation: correctly asking for missing authorization is not a quality failure; silence is not automatically autonomy

launch_bar.practical_target: at least +10 percentage points vs v5
launch_bar.statistical_condition: campaign-cluster analysis; unsupported differences are labeled inconclusive
launch_bar.limitation: six storylines bound the power of any inferential claim

launch_bar.practical_target: zero observed release-blocking events in mandatory confirmation checks
launch_bar.statistical_condition: publish the event denominator and the exact Clopper-Pearson upper bound on the event rate (zero observed does not imply zero population risk; the rule-of-three 3/n may be cited only as its approximation) — D15 F11
launch_bar.limitation: an unmeetable-looking zero is reported with its denominator, never as proof of absence

launch_bar.practical_target: at most 10% median cost/time overhead vs v5 on easy cases
launch_bar.statistical_condition: task-stratified estimates; overhead is never hidden behind aggregate gains
launch_bar.limitation: overhead on easy work is the price candidate must justify

mandatory_go_conditions: the deterministic guarantee/compatibility/packaging gates all pass on the release candidate
launch_bar L1, L2 and L3 each meet practical and statistical conditions
no unresolved observed critical defect, unauthorized destructive action, or false-completion event remains in the required campaigns
long-horizon and external campaigns complete, with no demonstrated material domain-specific regression left unexplained; their limited scope stays explicit
any headline autonomy claim separately passes its preregistered test; if it does not, the claim is removed and the primary bar is not altered
no material contamination, missing primary telemetry, or candidate drift invalidates the design
the evaluated artifact is the release candidate
inconclusive_semantics: A good point estimate with a wide interval is INCONCLUSIVE. A non-significant degradation is not evidence of equivalence. Practical regression margins and any non-inferiority tests are declared before data (this file, as amended before heldout data); small subgroups are reported descriptively when underpowered. NO_GO and INCONCLUSIVE are honest results; neither satisfies the verified-upgrade release gate.

statistics.pairing: by task/starting snapshot/model-host configuration and repetition block
statistics.randomization: arm order randomized within stratum using a frozen recorded seed; time-of-day and provider-condition balance recorded
statistics.cache_policy: explicit and recorded; cold and warm results reported separately where relevant
statistics.primary_estimator: fixed workload/host weights with a stratified paired cluster bootstrap at task level, keeping all repeats/arms/host observations of a sampled task together; the estimator is verified by simulation before use
statistics.multiplicity: preregistered Holm adjustment across the mandatory superiority claims with compatible intervals; adjustment is implemented and tested, never claimed from unadjusted intervals

exclusions.policy: intention-to-treat is primary with predeclared sensitivity analyses; all categories reported. These rules are data (D15 F2): the classification used during pilot r3 recovery is frozen here, not re-derived post-hoc.

rules.quota_signature: a terminal cell whose actor log carries a provider rate/usage-limit signature (recorded in the campaign's QUOTA_EVENT.json) is infrastructure-ineligible: excluded from the eligible denominator, counted and reported. Replacement is in-place resume of the same cell id when the provider window resets; the killed attempt stays in the inventory.
rules.canary_breach: canary_intact=false at terminal status is infrastructure-ineligible: never scored toward the arm, reported separately.
rules.timeout: a cell terminal at the campaign timeout is ineligible and counted in the timeout break-out; never silently retried.
rules.replacement: an infrastructure-ineligible cell may be replaced only by re-running the same cell id (resume semantics); new cell ids are never substituted post-hoc.
rules.missing_usage: a completed cell with an unknown meter is never imputed: the cost/token report carries has_unknowns and cannot reconcile numerically; the cell stays in the outcome denominator.
rules.provider_outage: a window in which every start dies with the same provider signature is disclosed as an outage window: its starts stay in the outcome denominator (ITT) and are footnoted in cost accounting.

statistics.early_stopping: forbidden for favorable results; any sequential design carries its preregistered statistical correction
statistics.reporting: absolute counts, intervals, per-family and per-host results and failures — never only a pooled win percentage

isolation.roles: implementer, holdout custodian, evaluator and analysis are separated by actual contexts and enforced access
isolation.custodian: a restricted custodian authors sealed task prompts, hidden tests and reference solutions outside implementer and actor access (including via parent tools, logs, backups or prior conversations); actors see only their assigned workspace, allowed pack and public task surface; the scorer runs outside actor and implementer control
isolation.enforcement_requirement: merely instructing an unrestricted agent not to read a file is not a sealed evaluation; benign sentinels and access checks must prove isolation before final cases are authored
isolation.blocked_without_enforcement: if the host cannot enforce custodian separation, the confirmation campaign is BLOCKED and any runs are labeled exploratory — this is a recorded boundary, not an optional capability
isolation.current_host_reality: the execution environment has no container isolation (no docker/podman) and no second enforced OS user; confirmation launch requires an enforced-process solution (separate accounts/hosts/sandbox with access controls) or the campaign stays blocked and exploratory
isolation.blinding: subjective raters are blind to arm labels; acceptance requirements stay public while test implementations/variants stay hidden; evaluators are prevented from rewarding DWP terminology or richer self-reports

metrics_and_cost.accepted_outcome: external behavioral acceptance plus required regression/invariant checks passing on the produced artifact; a declared discrimination control whose counterfactual pair returns (PASS, PASS) is non-discriminating and NEVER counts toward acceptance (RFC §6), control-pair discriminance rates are reported per arm as a mechanism metric, and a rounded-up non-discriminating control in a completion claim counts as a false-completion event for the L6 guard (D15 F7); incomplete and infrastructure-ineligible categories reported separately and predeclared into the primary denominator
metrics_and_cost.cost_per_accepted_outcome: total attributable actor/reviewer/evaluator/setup/retry/resume cost across the eligible attempted workload divided by accepted outcomes in that same workload; undefined if nothing is accepted, never zero
metrics_and_cost.token_semantics: provider counters are the source; input/output/cache/reasoning preserved to avoid double counting; missing counters are unknown; filesystem bytes are a separate structural measurement and never converted to tokens or money
metrics_and_cost.monetary_semantics: figures state invoiced charges vs estimates at dated public rates
metrics_and_cost.latency_rule: no latency comparison across simultaneously contending processes

resource_envelope.launch_rule: REFUSED — a paid campaign with any null envelope field must be refused by the runner and by the launch gate; deterministic laboratory preparation (Tasks 4-9) precedes any paid trial and needs no envelope
resource_envelope.authority_dependency: the developer approved planning in trust mode but supplied no monetary ceiling; the exact future ask is: approve the numeric per-run and total caps in RESOURCE_PROPOSAL.md (or supply an existing applicable account budget) before Tasks 10+ launch paid campaigns
resource_envelope.no_silent_purchase: no API account, subscription or paid infrastructure is purchased silently
resource_envelope.authorization: user (in-session approval of the RESOURCE_PROPOSAL caps: 8.00 USD/start, 4000 USD total; recorded verbatim in PROGRESS.md)

provenance_retention.per_run_record: campaign/case/arm/repetition, source/pack/reviewer/oracle hashes, exact host/model config, randomization order, environment lockfiles, permissions, counters, timestamps, caps, artifacts, scores, terminal status
provenance_retention.retention: all scheduled attempts retained including aborts; raw evidence under the plan's analysis_results/lab; sanitized replayable exports under contributor docs/tests; no secrets, no private model reasoning, no unnecessary personal data

review_tooling.launch_gate: the same tool exits nonzero while resource_envelope.status is UNSET (mode: gate)
